description: Turns twelve drum gates into one polyphonic track of General MIDI drum notes, gates and velocities

inputs.text: A gate for the drum named above it; while a cable is in this jack that drum takes a channel on all three outputs, and the voltage here is passed straight to the gate output
Sets the velocity of the drum named above it, passed straight through as a voltage on the velocity output; unpatched, that channel carries the voltage for velocity 100

outputs.text: The note of each triggered drum, 1V per octave, one channel per gate jack that has a cable in it
The gate of each triggered drum, passed through from its gate jack, one channel per gate jack that has a cable in it
The velocity of each triggered drum, one channel per gate jack that has a cable in it

notes: click the name above a pair of jacks to choose which General MIDI drum that pair sends; the names are drawn by the module, not parameters, so no click on them reaches this help
channels are packed: only jacks with a cable get a channel on the outputs, and they are numbered in panel order from the top left
the module starts on kick, low tom, snare, mid tom, side stick, high tom, pedal hi-hat, hand clap, closed hi-hat, crash, open hi-hat and ride
the three outputs are made to be patched into a MIDI Recorder row or into Rack's own CV-MIDI
